final: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN p.ID END) as abnormal_males, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN p.ID END) as abnormal_females, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN p.ID END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN p.ID END) as male_to_female_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
